behaviors.note: The 023-01 references are the Task 023 task-local audit scripts (audit_residuals.mjs, redteam_audit.mjs), which fail closed on drift of the signed Task 020-022 closures. The runner validates their existence; their execution is bound to the Task 023 closure HEAD because later legitimate shared-file edits (e.g. route-parity.md re-owned by Task 024) intentionally advance the newest-owner boundary. Re-running them at the 024 HEAD would report that shared-file drift, which is the known historical-drift item kept open at the change level.
